description_en: Queries the number of daily active users and streaming daily active users by date
description_zh: 按日期查询日活跃用户数和流式接入日活跃用户数
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-dau-report-data --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-date '2026-09-01 00:00:00' --end-date '2026-09-30 23:59:59' --product-type CloudApp --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDauReportData

parameters.help_en: The ID of the app instance group, which is used to filter data for a specific app instance group. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID. If this parameter is not specified, data is not filtered by app instance group
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于筛选指定交付组的数据。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取；不传时不按交付组筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 200. If the specified value is greater than 1,500, the value is processed as 1,500
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。不传时默认 200；大于 1500 时按 1500 处理
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Specify a value starting from 1. If this parameter is not specified, the service processes the request as the first page, but the response may return 0
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码。建议从 `1` 开始显式传入；不传时服务按首页处理，但响应可能回显 `0`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business region, which is used to filter report data. You can call the [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，用于筛选报表数据。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the statistics period. This parameter is required. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The service extracts the natural day in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The date range is inclusive and cannot exceed 180 days. The string does not contain a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`；服务按 `yyyy-MM-dd` 取自然日。日期范围包含起止日期，跨度不能超过 180 天。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the statistics period. This parameter is required. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The value cannot be earlier than StartDate. The service extracts the natural day in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The string does not contain a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，且不能早于 `StartDate`；服务按 `yyyy-MM-dd` 取自然日。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The product type. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not specified or is unrecognized, the query defaults to CloudApp.

Valid values:

CloudApp: Wuying Cloud App.
CloudBrowser: Cloud browser.
WuyingServer: Enterprise Edition workstation.
WuyingWorkstation: Personal Edition Linggou container workstation.
WuyingWorkstationTeam: Linggou Team Edition container workstation.
WuyingWorkstationBusiness: Linggou Dedicated Edition container workstation.
AndroidCloud: Cloud phone.
AIAgent: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。可选；未传入或无法识别时按 `CloudApp` 查询。

取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

Code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is processed successfully. Other values indicate that the processing failed
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败

Count.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
Count.description_zh: 满足查询条件的记录总数

DauReportDataModel.description_en: The list of daily active user report data
DauReportDataModel.description_zh: 日活跃用户报表数据列表

Dau.description_en: The number of active users within the statistical epoch. Unit: users
Dau.description_zh: 统计周期内的活跃用户数。单位：人

StatDate.description_en: The statistics date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. The string does not contain a time zone and is interpreted as a natural date in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
StatDate.description_zh: 统计日期，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd`。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然日期解释

StreamingDau.description_en: The number of active users who generated sessions through streaming access within the statistical epoch. Unit: users
StreamingDau.description_zh: 统计周期内通过流式接入产生会话的活跃用户数。单位：人

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result. Typically, success is returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 请求处理结果说明。请求成功时通常返回 `success`

PageNumber.description_en: The page number corresponding to the current response

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page used in the current response
PageSize.description_zh: 本次响应采用的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题
